http://advancedsportschiropractic.com/ We are the premier sports enthusiast rehab center in Bellingham, where we do things a little bit different. What Dr. Curtis does works for athletes of all ages, and works for everyone else just as well.
 
Dr. Curtis combines the benefits of chiropractic adjustments and joint mobilizations with advanced soft tissue work and exercise/stretching/muscle rehab (similar to what is done in physical therapy).
 
This unique combination provides the best outcomes for resolving both acute injuries and the chronic pain that plagues your activity. Not many physical therapists or chiropractors put the two approaches together in the same way Dr. Curtis does, and it works!
